props.name: render
props.description: Replaces the host `<h2>` via base-ui `useRender`. Use this for other outline levels; the level-2 type classes and `data-slot` stay merged onto the replacement.

props.name: layout
props.description: How terms and details sit. `responsive` stacks each details under its term on phones and sets them in two columns, with a rule between rows, from `sm` up. `inline` keeps each term and its details on one row at every width, for label/value rows in cards and summaries: the details align to the end, a short one never wraps and a long one wraps within 60% of the row. Inline rows take the label type, have no rules and space with the small surface gap, and the term is not muted. A colour class on a cell wins in both layouts. The inline cells' padding, rules, column and alignment come from the list, so override them with a `[:where([data-layout=inline])>&]:` class or a CSS rule. Defaults to `responsive`.
